calls.title: Ashley/Charlie
calls.summary: The team is addressing discrepancies between revenue data sources, particularly between Stripe and investor figures, with significant mismatches observed in monthly recurring revenue (MRR). They are also reviewing approximately $700K worth of failed invoices to assess recoverable revenue and identify billing system issues. There is a need for clarification on the enterprise billing flow, as many customers still utilize Stripe for payments instead of the expected Orb system. Additionally, initial churn data lists for pro and enterprise customers have been created to manage customer retention more effectively. The team is also planning significant operational improvements to ensure data consistency and integrate various systems, with attention to upcoming meetings for continued progress.
calls.keywords: Revenue reconciliation, failed invoices, enterprise billing, churn analysis, system integration, process redesign

Send updated workbook with all reconciled data, including failed invoices and churned customers, to Ashley and Jennifer for ongoing action (22:08)
